messages.author: 1833da6b0680d51f
messages.subject: Re: Can I calculate Log-Likelihood values in model with WLSMV estimator?
parts:
No you can't. The WLSMV estimator does not maximize the log-likelihood, hence the value cannot be computed for WLSMV - and you can't get information indices as the BIC.

C.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Can I calculate Log-Likelihood values in model with WLSMV estimator?
parts:
WLSMV and friends (DWLS, WLS, GLS, ULS, with or without MV) are
estimation methods based on least squares. There is simply no likelihood
involved. So there can not be a (log)likelihood, or any other measure
that depends on it: AIC and BIC.

Yves.
